title: Loyi Muvabyi
intro: Khale, emasikwini yo sungula ya matimu ya vanhu, mimoya-xiviri yimbirhi a yi yime emahlweni ka Muvumbi wa yona yi ri ni magandzelo. Un’wana u amukeriwile, un’wana a nga amukeriwanga. Leswi landzeleke a swi ta va khombo ro sungula lerikulu exikarhi ka vamakwavo - xiendlo xin’we xo tikhoma hi ku lehisa mbilu na xiendlo xin’we xo rihisela hi ndlela yo vava. Xana u nga paluxa leswi ndzi nga swona?
clues: Ndzi velekiwe emasikwini yo sungula swinene ya vukona bya munhu emisaveni
A ndzi ri n’wana wa mpatswa wo sungula swinene wa vanhu lowu tshameke wu famba emisaveni leyi
Ndzi tshame ndzi endla gandzelo leri humaka eka lavanene ngopfu eka ntlhambi wa mina leswaku ndzi tsakisa Muvumbi wa mina
Gandzelo ra mina ri amukeriwe ku suka ehenhla, kasi gandzelo ra makwerhu ri ariwile
Loko ndzi xungetiwa hi rifu, ndzi hlawule ku nga tlakusi voko ra mina eka makwerhu wa mina
Ndzi ve munhu wo sungula ematin’wini hinkwawo ya vanhu ku dlayiwa hi ndlela leyi hoxeke hi un’wana

Nuh (Nowa) .

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
